entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: Information element that indicates the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type the message is sent over and are active in the network.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the PDU session status IE when it needs to indicate active PDU sessions.

entities.name: Network needs to indicate active PDU sessions
entities.description: Condition that triggers the inclusion of the PDU session status IE by the network.

relations.description: Network includes the PDU session status IE in the message.
The condition that the network needs to indicate active PDU sessions guards the inclusion of the PDU session status IE.
